title: Return Window, Restocking Fee and Opened Items: Ostomy Supply Program Tiers
content:
For the Ostomy Supply Program, three return terms are set per payer tier: the return request window, the restocking fee withheld from a credit, and whether opened supplies are returnable.

- **Return window** - the window for requesting the return of unopened, sealed items, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date of the shipment.
- **Restocking fee** - the fee withheld from the credit for an accepted return, as a percent of the amount the customer paid for the returned units; a whole percent.
- **Opened items returnable** - whether opened medical supplies may be returned for credit.

| Tier | Return window | Restocking fee | Opened items returnable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | 30 days | 15% | No |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | 30 days | 0% | No |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | 30 days | 0% | No |

**Points of reading.** The return window is 30 days and opened supplies are not returnable on every tier. A restocking fee applies only on the Ostomy Self-Pay Program, at 15% of the amount paid for the returned units.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a self-pay customer who paid USD 40.00 for units that are accepted back unopened has USD 6.00 (15% of USD 40.00) withheld, for a credit of USD 34.00.
